findings.summary: Grouping uses alphabetical sorting of locality keys, which destroys stable input priority.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove the `.sort()` call when iterating over `byLocality.keys()`. `Map` preserves insertion order, so iterating the keys directly ensures batches are yielded in the exact input priority order of their first comment.

findings.summary: The batch cap splits comments in the same hunk into multiple batches, violating the 'one stable batch' invariant for hunks.
findings.suggested_fix: Apply the chunking loop (`i += MAX_BATCH_SIZE`) exclusively to fallback groups where `hunkIdentity` is undefined. If a `hunkIdentity` exists, push all `localComments` as a single un-capped batch.

findings.summary: The test 'comments in same hunk form one batch even when beyond file cap' incorrectly places the 6th comment in a different hunk.
findings.suggested_fix: Adjust the line numbers in the test so all 6 comments overlap the first hunk (e.g., lines 3 through 8). Currently, comment 6 is on line 22, completely dodging the invariant it claims to test.
